description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using the Lightning.js framework. It includes a template with animated circles and manages an alpha state that toggles to create a fade-in and fade-out loading animation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that displays animated circles as a loading indicator.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval that toggles the alpha value to animate the loader.
